verdicts.reason: As far as I can see, A and B are the same image. In both, the headline and the phone work, but the CTA has shrunk to about the size of the badges. It sits in a tight centred stack with the 'Back by Demand' and 'Summer Only' pills, so it no longer stands out, and it now comes before the badges, unlike the original. The right column is cramped, 'Summer Only' nearly touches the bottom edge, the subhead is tiny, and the phone is small next to the big empty space above it.
